commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.

90+4' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Arsenal are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

90+1' 2 - 0 Goal! Mikel Merino displays great vision and sends a pass to Bukayo Saka (Arsenal), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the top of the net. The score is 2:0.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.

89' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom right corner. However, he couldn't beat Caoimhin Kelleher, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.

89' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) unleashes a promising shot low towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Caoimhin Kelleher thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
87' Arsenal enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
85' Looks like Igor Thiago (Brentford) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
85' Piero Hincapie (Arsenal) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
83' Declan Rice is being substituted because of an injury. Mikel Arteta sends Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) on the pitch.
83' Declan Rice (Arsenal) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
81' Declan Rice (Arsenal) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
79' Arsenal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
77' Brentford take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
77' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Brentford win a corner.
74' Keith Andrews has decided to substitute Rico Henry and he is replaced by Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford).
74' Substitution. Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) replaces Ethan Pinnock.
73' Brentford control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
70' It looks like Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) saw red with that tackle. Tony Harrington won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
69' Mikel Merino (Arsenal) blows a clear opportunity! He needed only to tap the ball in, but narrowly misses the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
69' Declan Rice (Arsenal) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Caoimhin Kelleher easily deals with the threat.
68' The Arsenal players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
66' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Caoimhin Kelleher has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
66' The free kick is taken by Declan Rice (Arsenal), but ball is cleared.
65' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) was quite harsh and Tony Harrington didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
64' Michael Kayode (Brentford) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.

60' Brentford are seeing far more of the ball now.
57' Neat passing move from Arsenal in order to create new attacking opportunities.

42' Cristhian Mosquera (Arsenal) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

41' Mikel Merino (Arsenal) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
38' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

37' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Arsenal.
36' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Arsenal.
35' 67:33 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
33' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
32' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) takes a short corner kick.

32' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Arsenal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
30' Brentford are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

28' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
25' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Ben White (Arsenal) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
24' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) is penalised for a foul. Tony Harrington had a clear view and blows his whistle.

21' David Raya makes a beautiful save from Kevin Schade (Brentford), who latched on to an accurate lofted pass and produced a timely header. The goalkeeper was able to tip the ball onto the bar and away.
21' There's an opportunity for Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
20' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The linesman points to the corner flag, Brentford are going to take it.
20' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) takes the corner which is cleared.
19' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) commits a foul and Tony Harrington immediately signals a free kick.

17' What a miss! Ben White (Arsenal) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.

17' Nice individual effort by Noni Madueke (Arsenal). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a shot to the middle of the goal, but Caoimhin Kelleher does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
14' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

11' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Mikel Merino (Arsenal) makes it 1:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Ben White and planted his close-range header into the middle of the goal. Caoimhin Kelleher was helpless.
10' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
9' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
8' Ben White (Arsenal) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
6' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
4' Declan Rice (Arsenal) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
4' Great teamplay by Arsenal as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
2' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
